info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Syndicate Management API
info.description: The Syndicate Management API enables users to efficiently access and manage syndicate-related information within the banking domain. It supports operations for retrieving detailed data about external agencies involved in syndicate activities. This API is particularly useful for financial analysts and compliance officers who need to inquire about agency partnerships and syndicate involvement. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their oversight and ensure effective management of their external agency relationships.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a specific syndicate in the external agency.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch comprehensive details about a particular syndicate identified by its unique resource ID (RES-100045) within the external agency's syndicate management system. It provides insights into the syndicate's status, members, and relevant actions.
